summary: This 469,726 sq ft, 9-story parking structure at 150 Warriors Way in Mission Bay South was built in 2009, per DataSF Assessor records -- roughly a decade before Chase Center opened next door -- and serves Chase Center and other Mission Bay South uses.

milestones.text: SF Dept. of Building Inspection permit #200705090778 filed to erect the 7-story parking garage at this address

sources.title: Assessor Historical Secured Property Tax Rolls (blklot 8721030, 150 Warriors Way / 450 South St): year_property_built 2009

Building Permits: permit #200705090778 (450 South St, block 8721 lot 012 at filing -- now 150 Warriors Way / lot 030), filed 2007-05-09, "to erect parking garage with 7 stories new building", completed 2009-10-23, estimated cost $34,000,000
sources.publisher: DataSF / SF Department of Building Inspection

open_questions: Exact month/day of the 2009 completion is not sourced, only the year.

The 2007 permit's own block/lot (block 8721, lot 012) differs from the lot the Assessor now uses for this address (lot 030) and its address is given as 450 South St rather than 150 Warriors Way; the 7-story parking-garage description and 2009-10-23 permit-completion date (matching the Assessor's 2009 year) line up with this parcel, so this is treated as a lot/address renumbering (this session's own permit search elsewhere on this block confirms 450 South St and 150 Warriors Way are used interchangeably for this garage), not a different building.

This garage's own construction (2009) predates Chase Center itself, which this pass did not independently source an opening date for -- the two are not on the same construction timeline, contrary to the possibility raised in this thread's brief.
